raw.rationale: A pan-BCL2/BCL-xL/BCL-W inhibitor at 2.5 µM for 5 days should broadly kill many lines, but selective lineage killing is most plausible in BCL2/BCL-xL-dependent hematologic lineages; among the listed solid lineages, SCLC (lung) and possibly neuroblastoma/CNS have documented BCL2 family dependence, while most others lack strong evidence. Thus probabilities are low overall, with modest enrichment for lung and central_nervous_system.
